title: What If You Were Trapped in a Heatwave With Your CRUSH?
tags: what if the world got too hot
description:
It's 57°C outside. The power is gone. Every fridge in town is warm… except one walk-in freezer in the back of a shut-down ice cream shop. And the girl holding the key is your crush.

She slides a piece of paper under the door. It says "Rules." There are four of them. The fourth one has your name in it.

Twelve people fit inside. Forty are waiting. Twenty minutes in, forty minutes out. Nobody skips. Nobody trades. And Gus does NOT get special treatment.

Then a guy named Derek shows up with a crowbar. The diesel gauge hits 40%. And your brother will not stop whispering "special treatment."

In this episode of Gus Maybe:
– Why a wet-bulb temperature of 35°C kills a healthy adult in hours (and why newer studies say the real limit is closer to 31)
– Why 40 people in a freezer turns it into an oven
– Why asphalt gets 20–30°C hotter than the air
– What happened in the 2003 European heatwave
– And why Rule 4 gets cancelled

If your crush was running the list… would you follow the rules, or would you be Derek? Comment "list" or "crowbar."

Same girl. Opposite problem → What If You Got Locked in a Freezer With Your Crush? https://youtu.be/[LINK DO FREEZER]

Subscribe for a new What If every day.
